SEP does call him a relativist ('skeptical and relativist implications'; 'His ethical relativism grew out of his indexical understanding'), and IEP b. calls the radical relativist reading 'clearly a misreading'. But 'holding all views equal' is the radical version (Guo Xiang's 'equalization of all viewpoints') that IEP rejects. SEP never says Zhuangzi held all views equal; it ties his relativism to how words are used. As written, SEP is made to endorse the view IEP attacks. New claim.
